{{Quote|You're late, 264. Plug in.|The technician to "264"|<ref name="RR" />}}
A '''technician''' served under a unidentified officer in the blockade above [[Lothal]]. When [[C1-10P|Chopper]], disguised as droid [[264]], arrived on the light cruiser ''[[Tellstar]]'', he told him he was late and told him to plug in. However, the data did not come in, and the technician told his officer that the droid was malfunctioning.<ref name="RR" />
